subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.explain: 'Packen' = 'to pack' and 'die Koffer' = 'the suitcases', so this means 'to pack the suitcases'.
'Das Oktoberfest' is the famous folk festival/funfair held in Munich.
'Die Einwohner' means 'the inhabitants/residents' of a place.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would rather go to the mountains'?
options: Ich fahre nie in die Berge
Ich fahre lieber in die Berge
Ich fahre selten in die Berge
questions.explain: 'Lieber' means 'rather/preferably', so 'Ich fahre lieber in die Berge' = 'I'd rather go to the mountains'.
'Die Innenstadt' means 'the town/city centre'; 'der Stadtrand' is the outskirts.
'Im Ausland' means 'abroad'. 'Das Ausland' = foreign countries; 'das Inland' = home country.

questions.q: How do you say 'We spent the holidays by the sea'?
options: Wir verbringen die Ferien am Meer
Wir haben die Ferien in den Bergen verbracht
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer gebraucht
questions.explain: 'Am Meer' = 'by the sea' and 'verbracht' (perfect of 'verbringen') = 'spent'; 'gebraucht' (needed) is the trap.

questions.q: How do you say 'The hotel was right by the beach'?
options: Das Hotel ist direkt am Strand
Das Hotel war weit vom Strand
Das Hotel war direkt am Strand
Das Hotel war direkt an der Straße
questions.explain: 'War' = 'was', 'direkt am Strand' = 'right by the beach'; 'Straße' (street) is the trap.
'Der Flug' means 'the flight'; 'fliegen' = 'to fly'. ('Der Fluss' = river is the near-miss.)

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I have lived here for ten years'?
options: Ich werde hier zehn Jahre wohnen
Ich wohne seit zehn Jahren hier
Ich wohnte vor zehn Jahren hier
Ich wohne hier seit zehn Tagen
questions.explain: 'Seit' + present tense = 'for/since'; 'seit zehn Jahren' = 'for ten years'.
'Die Sehenswürdigkeiten' means 'the sights/tourist attractions' worth seeing.
'Auf dem Land' means 'in the countryside'; 'in der Stadt' = 'in the town'.
'Das Rathaus' means 'the town hall' (from 'Rat' = council), not anything to do with rats.
